//: What the survivor village's work asks for, keyed by the quest ids of the game's original village content. Original Prologue numbers; the ids name whitelisted things. calories: food handed over, by its calories (never rotten). items: rows of { anyOf, count } (charges for charge-counted things). distinct_food: that many different cooked dishes - food some recipe makes - each worth at least minKcal. distinct_parts: parts from that many different ids of 'from'. install: carried to the place and used up there. retrieve: the one item. decryptMinutes: how long a drive takes to read once handed in. steward: done when the story flag named by 'story' is set (the Steward stopped). scout (12.10.2026): taking the work on marks the 'count' nearest places of 'types' that have not been searched yet, wherever they are. worsenEveryDays / worsenStages: while the work is unfinished, the one who is ill is shown worse every that many days, that many times (nobody dies of it). reward.bionicChoice: the survivor picks one of these modules on handing in, and the autodoc fits that one for nothing and without risk.
